source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Access thermal components
steps.body: Remove toe panel. Measure resistance from red wire at thermal cut-off to red wire at heater element.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove toe panel. Measure resistance from red wire at thermal cut-off to red wire at heater element.

steps.title: Thermal cut-off to heater — ~10 Ω
steps.body: Red at thermal cut-off to red at heater should read about 10 Ω (7–12 Ω element path). Open — check thermal cut-off, high-limit, and element continuity.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Red at thermal cut-off to red at heater should read about 10 Ω (7–12 Ω element path). Open — check thermal cut-off, high-limit, and element continuity.

branches.label: Out of spec
branches.oemOutcome: Replace open heater, thermal cut-off, or high-limit per component test.

branches.label: Borderline / warning
branches.oemOutcome: Replace open heater, thermal cut-off, or high-limit per component test.

branches.label: Open circuit
branches.oemOutcome: Replace open heater, thermal cut-off, or high-limit per component test.

steps.title: P14-3 to P14-6 at MCE
steps.body: At MCE: measure P14-3 to P14-6. 5–15 kΩ → replace MCE. Less than 1 kΩ → replace exhaust thermistor. Greater than 20 kΩ (heat won't shut off) → replace thermistor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At MCE: measure P14-3 to P14-6. 5–15 kΩ → replace MCE. Less than 1 kΩ → replace exhaust thermistor. Greater than 20 kΩ (heat won't shut off) → replace thermistor.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace machine control electronics — P14 thermistor circuit indicates MCE fault.

steps.title: Replace heater path component
steps.oemOutcome: Replace failed element, thermal cut-off, or high-limit.

steps.title: Heater circuit verified
steps.oemOutcome: Heating circuit and P14 thermistor path within spec at test points.
